messages.en: This message looks like a scam. I don't want to click that link.
I think so too. Check the official website first.
I want to ask that building caretaker first if we can park here.
Sure, just ask him. He's by the entrance.
Has the bad guy in that show been caught yet?
Not yet. He's still hiding in that old house.

senses.en_definition: A place where convicted offenders are confined as punishment; imprisonment.
A situation in which a person feels trapped or deprived of freedom.

collocations.en: a prison of one's own experiences

messages.en: That character's out of prison now, right? I missed that bit earlier because I went to get some food.
Not yet. He's still in prison. That scene earlier where he saw his younger sibling was just a flashback.
